about_short_description.short_description: Workbase is a data visualization and analytics tool for account/growth teams.

product.name: Workbase Platform
product.description: A data automation platform that transforms raw data into actionable workflows and alerts for account and growth teams.

product.name: Formulas and Analytics
product.description: A feature that enables users to create custom calculations and filters on data records to drive alerts and automations.

product.name: Automated Workflows and Actions
product.description: Automations that trigger actions such as sending messages, updating records, or syncing data based on defined conditions.

product.name: Workbooks
product.description: Organizational units within Workbase that group formulas, analytics, and automations for specific projects or use cases.

product.name: Data Connections and Integrations
product.description: Connectors to data sources and end systems like Salesforce, Hubspot, Snowflake, and Slack for data ingestion and action execution.
